data.gender_notes: Aabirah is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient
data.long_meaning: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿābira (عابرة), the feminine active participle of ʿabara 'to cross, to pass through', from the root ʿ-b-r. Aabirah therefore means “Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿābira 'she who crosses'; spelling variant of Aabira.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabirah expresses “The last one”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿābira (عابرة), the feminine active participle of ʿabara 'to cross, to pass through', from the root ʿ-b-r.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabirah total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

faq.q: Is Aabirah the same name as Aabira?
faq.a: Yes - Aabirah and Aabira are two English spellings of the same Arabic name عابرة, meaning 'she who crosses, female passer-by'.

faq.q: What does the name Aabirah mean?
faq.a: Aabirah means “Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabirah come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabirah?
faq.a: The root of Aabirah is ع-ب-ر (ʿ-b-r).

faq.q: How is Aabirah written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabirah is written عابرة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabirah a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabirah is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aabirah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabirah is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabirah verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Female passer-by; she who crosses; transient” is established by Arabic feminine active participle ʿābira 'she who crosses'; spelling variant of Aabira..
